topic.title: Bayesian Neural Inference and Structured Uncertainty
topic.area: Continuous Models and Scientific Machine Learning
topic.overview: Bayesian neural learning represents uncertainty through a distribution over models rather than a single fitted parameter vector. Because exact averaging is usually expensive, researchers study sampling, variational approximations, subnetworks, and compressed posterior representations. The quality of the resulting predictions depends both on the underlying model and on how its posterior is approximated.
topic.whyItMatters: Uncertainty estimates can look mathematically principled while missing important ambiguity between observed regions. Understanding approximation failures is therefore as important as reducing inference cost. Structured priors can additionally express which parts of functional inputs matter, linking prediction with interpretable uncertainty.
topic.evolution: A 1992 representative samples neural-network weights through stochastic dynamics. Later work develops practical posterior approximations and distillation. A 2020 study identifies function-space limitations of common variational families, while 2026 work combines Bayesian functional networks with region selection and theoretical consistency guarantees under its assumptions.
openQuestions: Which scalable approximations preserve uncertainty where training observations are sparse?
How can posterior checks distinguish poor priors from inaccurate inference?

papers.title: Do Bayesian Neural Networks Actually Behave Like Bayesian Models?
papers.tldr: Common approximate Bayesian neural-network methods empirically violate expected Bayesian updating properties, particularly under sequential learning.

papers.title: Generalization Bounds via Meta-Learned Model Representations: PAC-Bayes and Sample Compression Hypernetworks
papers.tldr: Hypernetwork encoders combine PAC-Bayesian and sample-compression ideas to derive generalization guarantees for generated predictors.

papers.title: Linearization Turns Neural Operators into Function-Valued Gaussian Processes
papers.tldr: LUNO converts Gaussian weight uncertainty into function-valued predictive uncertainty for trained neural operators through linearization.

papers.title: Optimization Proxies using Limited Labeled Data and Training Time – A Semi-Supervised Bayesian Neural Network Approach
papers.tldr: A semi-supervised Bayesian optimization proxy improves constraint satisfaction under limited data and training time while providing probabilistic performance bounds.

papers.title: Position: The Future of Bayesian Prediction Is Prior-Fitted
papers.tldr: The authors argue that prior-fitted networks and amortized inference can turn pretraining compute into useful Bayesian prediction for data-scarce applications.

papers.title: Rényi Neural Processes
papers.tldr: Rényi Neural Processes replace KL divergence to reduce the impact of prior misspecification and improve predictive log-likelihoods.

papers.title: Efficient Bayesian Experiment Design with Equivariant Networks
papers.tldr: Graph networks that respect domain permutations substantially reduce the training samples needed for learned Bayesian experiment design.

papers.title: Martingale Posterior Neural Networks for Fast Sequential Decision Making
papers.tldr: Predictive-first neural networks enable online Bayesian decisions with reported inference 10–100 times faster than classical Thompson sampling.

papers.title: NeuralSurv: Deep Survival Analysis with Bayesian Uncertainty Quantification
papers.tldr: NeuralSurv combines flexible deep survival modeling with efficient Bayesian inference to improve calibration and quantify uncertainty.

papers.title: Posterior Contraction for Sparse Neural Networks in Besov Spaces with Intrinsic Dimensionality
papers.tldr: Sparse Bayesian neural networks achieve optimal, smoothness-adaptive posterior contraction rates governed by intrinsic dimension for the studied Besov function classes.

papers.title: Squared families are useful conjugate priors
papers.tldr: Squared probability families can provide tractable conjugate priors and a multimodal Bayesian regression alternative that performs well in few-shot learning.

papers.title: VIKING: Deep variational inference with stochastic projections
papers.tldr: VIKING builds a correlated Bayesian approximation around parameter subspaces that distinguish functional changes inside and outside the training-data support.

papers.title: Distribution Transformers: Fast Approximate Bayesian Inference With On-The-Fly Prior Adaptation
papers.tldr: Distribution Transformers map changing priors and observed data to approximate posteriors, delivering millisecond inference in the evaluated tasks.

papers.title: GPan-LoRA: Gaussian Process Amortized Networks for Bayesian Low-Rank Adaptation in Large Language Models
papers.tldr: GPan-LoRA combines scalable Gaussian-process approximations with Bayesian adaptation to improve uncertainty calibration while preserving competitive task performance.

papers.title: Log-Normal Multiplicative Dynamics for Stable Low-Precision Deep Learning
papers.tldr: LMD translates biological synaptic dynamics into Bayesian weight learning to support stable training with low-precision forward computation.

papers.title: Position: The Time for Sampling Is Now! Charting a New Course for Bayesian Deep Learning
papers.tldr: The paper argues that Bayesian neural-network sampling is now computationally competitive and calls for better posterior exploration and sample distillation.

papers.title: Singular Bayesian Neural Networks
papers.tldr: Low-rank Bayesian weight posteriors reduce parameter costs while capturing correlations and improving several uncertainty measures in reported experiments.

papers.title: Sparse Bayesian Deep Functional Learning with Structured Region Selection
papers.tldr: sBayFDNN combines nonlinear functional prediction, uncertainty-aware region selection, and theoretical guarantees in a deep Bayesian model.

papers.title: SVRG and Beyond via Posterior Correction
papers.tldr: A Bayesian posterior-correction view recovers SVRG and yields new Newton-like and Adam-like optimization methods.

papers.title: Transformers Can Learn Posterior Predictive Distributions In-Context
papers.tldr: A constructive analysis shows how transformers can approximate Gaussian-process predictive distributions and links error and extrapolation to architectural choices.
